metadata.question: Does the stratospheric ozone concentration in the Arctic region (63-90 degrees North) increase in April 2014 compared to April 2011?

data.raw_code: The user asks about stratospheric ozone concentration in the Arctic region (63-90°N) in April 2014 compared to April 2011. Key considerations: 1. Dataset: Need stratospheric ozone data. Available options in GEE: - NASA/Aura/MLS/03_DGG: Daily global gridded ozone profiles at pressure levels (including stratospheric levels like 46hPa) - Alternative: MODIS total ozone (but that's total column, not stratospheric) 2. Geometry: Arctic region from 63°N to 90°N, all longitudes (-180 to 180) 3. Time: April 2011 and April 2014 (full month for each) 4. Processing: - Use MLS O3_46hPa band (ozone mixing ratio at ~20km altitude, stratospheric) - Mask unrealistic values (negative or >20 ppmv) - Calculate monthly mean for each year - Compare the two means 5. Fallbacks: If MLS has no data, try other levels or datasets? But question specifies stratospheric ozone. Data quality checks: - Check if collection has images for each period - Check if any valid pixels after masking - Validate results (ozone should be 0-20 ppmv typically) Output: Need to print concise evidence and final answer tag. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions // Arctic region: 63-90°N, all longitudes const arctic = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-180, 63, 180, 90], null, false); // Time periods: April 2011 and April 2014 const apr2011 = ee.DateRange('2011-04-01', '2011-04-30'); const apr2014 = ee.DateRange('2014-04-01', '2014-04-30'); // 2. Data Acquisition - MLS Stratospheric Ozone at 46 hPa const mlsCol = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/Aura/MLS/03_DGG') .select('O3_46hPa'); // Ozone mixing ratio at 46 hPa (~stratospheric) // Filter for each period const col2011 = mlsCol.filterDate(apr2011); const col2014 = mlsCol.filterDate(apr2014); // Check collection sizes const count2011 = col2011.size().getInfo(); const count2014 = col2014.size().getInfo(); console.log(`April 2011 Images: ${count2011}`); console.log(`April 2014 Images: ${count2014}`); // Case C1: Empty collection if (count2011 === 0 || count2014 === 0) { console.log('C1'); return; } // Create monthly composites (mean) const img2011 = col2011.mean(); const img2014 = col2014.mean(); // Mask unrealistic values (MLS valid range: 0-20 ppmv) const maskValid = function(img) { return img.updateMask(img.gte(0).and(img.lte(20))); }; const img2011Masked = maskValid(img2011); const img2014Masked = maskValid(img2014); // 3. Check valid pixels after masking const countReducer = ee.Reducer.count(); const scale = 1000; // 1km scale for MLS data const pixelCount2011 = img2011Masked.reduceRegion({ reducer: countReducer, geometry: arctic, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('O3_46hPa').getInfo(); const pixelCount2014 = img2014Masked.reduceRegion({ reducer: countReducer, geometry: arctic, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('O3_46hPa').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid Pixels 2011: ${pixelCount2011}`); console.log(`Valid Pixels 2014: ${pixelCount2014}`); // Case C2: No valid pixels if (pixelCount2011 === 0 || pixelCount2014 === 0) { console.log('C2'); return; } // 4. Calculate mean ozone concentration for each period const meanReducer = ee.Reducer.mean(); const mean2011 = img2011Masked.reduceRegion({ reducer: meanReducer, geometry: arctic, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('O3_46hPa').getInfo(); const mean2014 = img2014Masked.reduceRegion({ reducer: meanReducer, geometry: arctic, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('O3_46hPa').getInfo(); console.log(`Mean O3 2011: ${mean2011 ? mean2011.toFixed(4) : 'null'} ppmv`); console.log(`Mean O3 2014: ${mean2014 ? mean2014.toFixed(4) : 'null'} ppmv`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer // Case C3: Calculation failure or unrealistic values if (mean2011 === null || mean2014 === null || isNaN(mean2011) || isNaN(mean2014) || mean2011 < 0 || mean2011 > 20 || mean2014 < 0 || mean2014 > 20) { console.log('C3'); return; } // Compare concentrations const increase = mean2014 > mean2011; // Print evidence console.log(`Change: ${((mean2014 - mean2011) / mean2011 * 100).toFixed(1)}%`); // Final answer if (increase) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
